facts.text: Serve dessert when Andy packs up for college and the toys go in the box.
facts.why: Andy puts the toys in a bag for the attic, and only Woody goes in the college box. The donation box comes later, when his mum mistakes the bag for rubbish.
facts.fix: Serve dessert when Andy packs up for college and the toys go in the attic bag.
